title: 第21章 小馋猫笫22章 偶遇上
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
“嗝~~师父，我真的吃不下了。”
莉莉丝瘫在椅子上，面前摆着六个空盘子、三个空杯子、两个空碗，还有一个被她啃了一半就实在塞不进去的苹果。
她捂着肚子，银白色的长发散落在椅背上，整个人像一只被喂撑了的猫，连动一根手指的力气都没有了。
胃里正在进行一场激烈的内战——小蛋糕派和布丁派打得不可开交，蛋挞观光团在旁边看热闹，泡芙已经被挤到了食道的边缘，随时准备夺路而逃。
季天坐在对面，面前只有一杯已经凉了的茶。
强如季天，如今已经不需要食物来维持生命体征了，为了在弟子面前维持高人风范，也就索性不吃了。
“你出门时说想吃小蛋糕、蛋挞、蛋卷、布丁、泡芙、马卡龙、三明治……”他一项一项地报名字，语气平静得像在背诵功法口诀，“我全点了。你却只吃了不足一成。”
“那是因为——”莉莉丝的声音从桌面上飘上来，有气无力的，像一条被晒干的咸鱼在做最后的挣扎，“我以为每样只给一口的量……谁知道您老人家直接按人头点……我还以为是那种‘精致小点’，一口一个，吃完还能优雅地擦擦嘴……”
“我并不是很了解你们种族的食量，现在看来，是我高估了你。”
莉莉丝把脸埋进胳膊里，发出一声闷闷的哀嚎。
她觉得自己在师父眼里的形象大概率不是一个人，而是一头潜在的超级无敌大肥猪。
---
这家“金橡果”餐厅是科尔德城最大、最贵、最体面的餐厅。
白色桌布，银质餐具，水晶吊灯，连端盘子的侍者都穿着浆得笔挺的白衬衫，领结打得一丝不苟，走路带风，比一些落魄贵族还有派头。
季天带着一个裹着斗篷的银发少女走进来的时候，门口的侍者犹豫了一下，但还是恭敬地把他们领入门内——冒险家们大多出手阔绰，就算少数人想吃霸王餐，也不是自己一个小小的侍者惹得起的。
莉莉丝离开魔界以来，从来没有被这么客气的招待过。
逃了大半年，她吃过的最高级的食物，是路边捡到的半块面包——还是凉的，硬得能砸死哥布林。
有一次她在某个小镇的垃圾桶旁边发现了一个被人咬了一口就扔掉的苹果，她捡起来擦擦吃了，觉得那是人间美味。
现在回想起来，那大概是她逃难生涯的巅峰时刻了。
她看着菜单上那些想都不敢想的菜名——香草芝士焗龙虾、松露蘑菇汤、蜂蜜烤乳鸽、焦糖布丁、提拉米苏、马卡龙塔——觉得自己的眼泪都要从嘴角流下来了。

“想吃什么就点。”季天说，语气平淡得像在说“今天天气不错”。
她试探着点了一个小蛋糕。声音很小，像做贼一样。
季天轻叹一声，把菜单递给侍者，“菜单上有的，一样来一份。”
莉莉丝以为自己听错了。
侍者也以为自己听错了。
“哦，这可得花不少钱，先生。”
“一样来一份。”季天又重复了一遍，从紫府空间里摸出一袋金币放在柜台上。
那袋金币落在桌面上的声音，沉甸甸的，带着一种“不要用外表判断人”的金属质感。
侍者的表情立刻从怀疑变成了热情，又从热情变成了虔诚，腰弯得比门前的迎宾垫还低，又请他们移步到了靠窗最好的位置——采光好、视野佳、还能看到街景，是贵族小姐们最爱的打卡位。
然后莉莉丝就开始了她这辈子最幸福、也最痛苦的一顿饭。
幸福的是，每一样东西都好吃得她想哭。
那个小蛋糕入口即化，奶油像云朵一样轻盈；那个蛋挞的外皮酥脆得能听见“咔嚓”声，内馅甜而不腻；那个布丁滑嫩得像是用天使的眼泪做的，勺子一碰就颤巍巍地晃，像在跟她撒娇。
痛苦的是，她实在吃不完。
第一盘：好吃！
第二盘：太好吃了！
第三盘：有点饱了……
第四盘：师父我能不能歇一会儿？
第五盘：我觉得我的胃在疯狂肘击我的大脑。
content_en:
"Hiccup~ Master, I really can't eat anymore."
Lilith slumped on the chair. In front of her were six empty plates, three empty cups, two empty bowls, and an apple that she couldn't eat half of.
She was holding her stomach, her long silver-white hair scattered on the back of the chair. She looked like a cat that had been fed and stretched, and she didn't even have the strength to move a finger.
There was a fierce civil war going on in the stomach - the cake pie and the pudding pie were fighting fiercely, the egg tart tour group was watching the excitement, and the puffs had been squeezed to the edge of the esophagus, ready to escape at any time.
Ji Tian sat across from him, with only a cup of cold tea in front of him.
Qiang Ji Tian no longer needs food to maintain his vital signs. In order to maintain his superior demeanor in front of his disciples, he simply stops eating.
"When you went out, you said you wanted to eat small cakes, egg tarts, egg rolls, puddings, puffs, macarons, sandwiches..." He announced the names one by one, his tone as calm as if he was reciting the exercise formula, "I ordered them all. But you only ate less than 10%."
"That's because -" Lilith's voice floated up from the table, feebly, like a dried salted fish making its last struggle, "I thought each item was only for one mouthful... Who knew that you, the old man, ordered it directly on the head... I thought they were the kind of 'delicate little bits', one bite at a time, and you can wipe your mouth gracefully after eating..."
"I don't know much about your race's appetite. Now it seems that I overestimated you."
Lilith buried her face in her arms and let out a muffled wail.
She felt that her image in the eyes of her master was most likely not a person, but a potentially super invincible fat pig.
---
The Golden Acorn is Cold City's largest, priciest, and most respectable restaurant.
There are white tablecloths, silver tableware, crystal chandeliers, and even the waiters serving the dishes are wearing starched white shirts and meticulously tied bow ties. They walk with a wind, and are more elegant than some down-and-out nobles.
When Ji Tian walked in with a silver-haired girl wrapped in a cloak, the waiter at the door hesitated for a moment, but still led them in respectfully - most adventurers were generous, and even if a few people wanted to eat the Overlord's meal, it was not something that a small waiter like him could afford.
Lilith has never been treated so politely since she left the demon world.
After running away for more than half a year, the best food she had ever eaten was half a piece of bread picked up by the roadside - it was still cold and hard enough to kill a goblin.
Once she found an apple beside a trash can in a small town that had been thrown away after one bite. She picked it up and ate it, thinking it was a delicacy in the world.
Looking back now, that was probably the pinnacle moment of her escape career.
She looked at the unimaginable dish names on the menu - baked lobster with vanilla cheese, truffle mushroom soup, roasted squab with honey, crème brûlée, tiramisu, macaron tart - and felt that tears were about to flow from the corners of her mouth.
"Just order whatever you want to eat." Ji Tian said, his tone as calm as if he was saying "The weather is nice today."
She tentatively ordered a small cake. His voice was very low, like a thief.
Ji Tian sighed softly and handed the menu to the waiter, "Anything on the menu, please have one."
Lilith thought she heard wrongly.
The waiter also thought he heard wrongly.
"Oh, that's going to cost a lot of money, sir."
"One of the same." Ji Tian repeated again, took out a bag of gold coins from the Zifu space and placed it on the counter.
The sound of the bag of gold coins falling on the table was heavy, with a metallic texture that sounded like "Don't judge people by their appearance."
The waiter's expression immediately changed from suspicion to enthusiasm, and from enthusiasm to piety. He bent down lower than the welcome mat in front of the door, and invited them to move to the best seat by the window - it has good lighting, a good view, and can see the street view, which is the favorite of aristocratic ladies.Check-in position.
Then Lilith began the happiest and most painful meal in her life.
Happily, everything tasted so delicious that she wanted to cry.
The little cake melts in your mouth, and the cream is as light as a cloud; the egg tart has an outer shell so crispy that you can hear the "clicking" sound, and the filling is sweet but not greasy; the pudding is so smooth and tender that it looks like it is made of angel tears, and it trembles when the spoon is touched, as if it is coquettishly coquettish with her.
The painful thing is that she just can't finish it.
First plate: delicious!
Second plate: So delicious!
Plate 3: A little full...
Set 4: Master, can I take a break?
Set 5: I felt like my stomach was elbowing my brain like crazy.
